title: Biopython Lesson 1: Fundamentals of Central Dogma
description: Exploration of Bio.Seq objects, reverse complementation, transcription, and translation using standard IUPAC codon dictionaries.

title: SeqRecord & GenBank Parsing Seminar
description: High-throughput parsing of multi-feature GenBank (.gbk) and FASTA files using Bio.SeqIO with feature key extraction.

title: Homework 1: Central Dogma Operations
description: Comprehensive practical exercises on GC content calculation, codon frequency calculation, and melting temperature estimation.

title: Homework 4: Multiple Sequence Alignments
description: Parsing multi-species alignment matrices in Clustal, Phylip, and Stockholm formats using Bio.AlignIO.

title: Homework 5: Automated NCBI Entrez Queries
description: Programmatic retrieval of biomedical publications and nucleotide sequences via NCBI E-utilities (esearch, efetch).

title: Homework 8: Modern Dynamic Pairwise Alignment
description: Smith-Waterman and Needleman-Wunsch dynamic programming alignments via Bio.Align.PairwiseAligner with affine gap scoring.

title: Homework 11: Programmatic BLAST Interface
description: Submitting remote BLASTn and BLASTp queries to NCBI servers, XML parsing, and E-value threshold filtering.

title: Homework 14: Sequence Motifs & Position Weight Matrices
description: Derivation of Position Frequency Matrices (PFM), Position Weight Matrices (PWM), and information content logos.

title: Homework 15: In-Silico Restriction Enzyme Digestion
description: Mapping bacterial plasmid cleavage sites, double digests, and fragment length predictions using Bio.Restriction.

title: Homework 18: Molecular Phylogenetics & Tree Parsing
description: Reconstruction and visualization of phylogenetic trees using Bio.Phylo, Newick parsers, and distance matrix algorithms.

title: One-Way ANOVA: Drug Action on Enzyme Activity
description: Hypothesis testing on Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT) levels across 4 pharmacological dosage cohorts with post-hoc Tukey HSD.

title: Advanced Multi-Factor Factorial ANOVA
description: Two-factor and three-factor full factorial models, main effects evaluation, interaction significance, and effect size (eta-squared).

title: Extended ANOVA: Step-by-Step Variance Decomposition
description: Manual calculation of Sum of Squares (Total, Between, Within), Mean Squares, F-distribution p-values, and statistical power.

title: Clinical Trial Interaction Plots & Synergism Modeling
description: Quantifying treatment-by-time and drug-by-gender interactions in longitudinal randomized controlled clinical datasets.

title: Intermediate ANOVA: Model Diagnostics & Post-Hoc Tests
description: Verification of homoscedasticity (Levene's test), normality of residuals (Shapiro-Wilk, Q-Q plots), and Welch's robust ANOVA.

title: Protein-Ligand Interaction & 3D Binding Pocket Profiling
description: Parsing macromolecular crystallographic structures (1fat.cif, 1gbt.bcif), extracting ligand coordinates, and computing spatial contact networks.
